To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) online classes during Covid-19 pandemic did not represent full potential of online classes, but rather mimicked the traditional classes; (b) online classes were not well implemented due to the lack of mature technological supports and inadequate time to prepare; and (c) students encountered several obstacles during online classes.
the main obstacles of the online class are the lack of technology, the lack of teacher's knowledge of the platform, and lack of student's motivation to participate in the online class.
the main obstacles of online classes during pandemic were lack of interaction, lack of motivation, lack of technical skills, lack of time and lack of teacher’s support.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the obstacles encountered by students from an international department of a senior high school in Hangzhou during online courses in the 2019 Covid 19 period.
students and teachers’ experience of online education, and how it could be improved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
online education is an effective and feasible way to provide education to students.
, although online courses have been implemented in China for a long time, the pandemic has brought new challenges to online education.
the obstacles of current online classes during Covid-19 period were not caused by technology, but by teachers and students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, online courses are not the same as traditional classes.
, in the current online education system, the most common obstacle for students and teachers is the lack of adequate technological support.
the current online classes have not fully utilized the potential of online education and that the current online courses are not suitable for the current pandemic situation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers and students are not ready for the online classes, and the technology is not mature enough for the online classes.
online education is a great way to improve education, especially in China, and that it is important to provide adequate technological and human supports to make the online education a success.
, online classes should be more interactive and engaging.
